scenes.setting: First Backlund morning: the detective advertisement placed in the Backlund Bulletin, ritual materials bought across half the borough, Holy Night Powder ground at 15 Minsk Street
scenes.text_anchor: Klein started his first morning in Backlund under cold and humid weather conditions

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: The Fool takes his high-back chair and touches the crimson star of The Sun — one thing in the new life that hasn't changed
scenes.text_anchor: Klein took four steps counterclockwise and arrived above the gray fog.

scenes.setting: A half-collapsed tower outside the City of Silver: Derrick by the bonfire among his patrol squad feels the summons and feigns sleep (The Fool's call: vision only)
scenes.text_anchor: Nine members of a patrol squad were gathered around a blazing bonfire

scenes.setting: Empress Borough bedroom: Audrey waits eagerly for the summons — two weeks on, the Rainbow Salamander gland and Sequence 8 beckon
scenes.text_anchor: Using the excuse that she was tired, Audrey returned to her bedroom.

scenes.setting: The captain's cabin of an ancient sailboat: Alger memorizes copied diary pages, haunted by Qilangos's rotting face as the crimson tide takes him
scenes.text_anchor: Alger Wilson locked the door to the captain's cabin

scenes.setting: Tarot Club, palace above the gray fog: The Hanged Man tenders nineteen diary pages as payment for Qilangos — six arrive now, equivalent exchange
scenes.text_anchor: Having activated his Spirit Vision, Klein examined Justice, The Hanged Man, and The Sun

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude: 16th December — Roselle records contacting the pathetic fellow trapped in the storm, 'Mr. Door', and his offer of three wishes for a way back into the real world (reading continues into ch217)
scenes.text_anchor: Klein looked down and read the first page
